title: Velocity-Based-Training Bar-Speed Autoregulation
dataSources: Bar-velocity reps (`vbt:rep`), running gait (`gait:metric`), hangboard sessions (`hangboard:session`), golf-swing metrics (`golfswing:metric`), power-meter intervals (`powermeter:interval`), basketball shot arcs (`shotarc:make`).
app: Sports and skill sensors — velocity-based-training bar trackers, running-form IMUs, climbing hangboard load cells, golf launch monitors, cycling power meters, and computer-vision shot trackers — logged to Splunk HEC via APIs and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=vbt:rep
| stats avg(mean_velocity) as avg_v, max(mean_velocity) as best_v, count as reps by exercise load_kg
| eval velocity_loss=round(100*(best_v-avg_v)/best_v,1)
| sort exercise load_kg
description: Tracks bar speed across a lifting set so you can stop when velocity drops, training hard without grinding into junk fatigue.
value: Velocity loss is a live fatigue gauge; autoregulating by bar speed builds strength while avoiding the reps that only add risk.
implementation: Ingest bar-velocity reps into `index=personal`; review velocity loss per exercise and load to set stopping points.
visualization: Bar chart of velocity loss by exercise and load.
grandmaExplanation: It measures how fast you lift the bar and when it slows down, so you stop a set at the right time.
